summary: First fixing chat of the Kiln Build Preflight test audit (whole PRD). New tests raise AC-PREFLIGHT-08, AC-PREFLIGHT-02, AC-PREFLIGHT-06, AC-PREFLIGHT-05 and AC-ATTEND-05 from Weak to Adequate, and fresh re-graders confirmed each grade. The tests cover the Preflight row's placement on Documents found and in the run's plan, opening a finished or no-report row, the live controls' refusal reason, Codex with and without the skill, and the early-merge warning's look in real Chrome. Each new test was seen to fail with its behavior broken, and the full suite passes. AC-PREFLIGHT-01 and AC-PREFLIGHT-03 stay Weak and are recorded in test-audit.md for the next fixing chat. Only tests changed.
